definitions.meaning: An ancient work, the work of the creation
definitions.latin: opus priscum, res in principio creata

quotations.old_english: Woldon hie ædre gecýðan frumweorca fæder
quotations.english: they would at once proclaim the father of creation's works

source_text: frum-weorc, es; n. An ancient work, the work of the creation; &o-short;pus priscum, res in princ&i-short;pio cre&a-long;ta :-- Woldon hie ædre gecýðan frumweorca fæder they would at once proclaim the father of creation's works, Andr. Kmbl. 1607; An. 805.
